rule: Each row is a lane divergence the 16px tile rule sees and the whole-capture changed-pixel ratio does not. A row records the worst-tile ratio MEASURED ON EACH GATE HOST, because the same divergence rasterises differently per platform: side-nav.theme-dark reads 0.3984 on Windows and 0.2891 on macOS. A run is held to ITS OWN host's measurement, plus or minus tolerance - above it the divergence got worse, below it the divergence is gone and the row must be deleted. A host with no row for a listed scenario FAILS, naming HARBORLINE_GALLERY_PARITY_MEASURE: add that host's measurement the first time it runs the gallery gate. Never judge one host by another host's number, and never widen a window with a number nobody measured. A resolved entry that names a host says the divergence is gone on THAT host only: the row stands for the other hosts and the named host is held to the frozen tile threshold.
